ranking_record.quote: 4,C0029,Spielman-Teng conjecture on the least singular value of Bernoulli matrices,attempted_un,Spielman-Teng constant one
ranking_record.interpretation: Historical intake status only; current openness and exact statement unverified.

current_openness: UNKNOWN: 2025 published result has coefficient 1+o(1); targeted 2026 public search found no exact-coefficient resolution, which is not an exhaustive novelty check.
exact_primary_statement: For an n by n matrix B with independent uniform entries in {-1,+1}, there exists an absolute alpha in (0,1) such that P(s_min(B) <= t/sqrt(n)) <= t + alpha^n for every t >= 0, interpreted asymptotically; equivalently the original inverse-norm formulation uses P(||B^{-1}|| > u) <= sqrt(n)/u + alpha^n with singular matrices counted in the event.

original_primary_source.authors: Daniel A. Spielman and Shang-Hua Teng
original_primary_source.title: Smoothed Analysis of Algorithms
original_primary_source.locator: ICM 2002 survey, Conjecture 2, page 9 of Yale author PDF
original_primary_source.short_quote: Let A be a d-by-d matrix of independently and uniformly chosen ±1 entries.
original_primary_source.notation_note: The displayed remainder uses alpha^n after defining a d-by-d matrix; the least-singular-value restatement in later primary papers supplies the intended dimension parameter.

later_primary_sources.title: On the Spielman-Teng Conjecture
later_primary_sources.checked_result: For iid mean-zero variance-one subgaussian entries, P(s_min(M)<=t/sqrt(n)) <= (1+O((log n)^(-1/16)))t+exp(-Omega(n)); Bernoulli is included but exact coefficient one is not proved.

later_primary_sources.title: Random matrices: The distribution of the smallest singular values
later_primary_sources.checked_result: 1-exp(-t-t^2/2) is a limiting real-Gaussian CDF; Theorem 1.3 has uniform O(n^-c) distributional error.
